tags.chapter_name: General Principles and Processes of Isolation of Metals

question.text: Blister copper is refined by stirring molten impure metal with green logs of wood because such a wood liberates hydrocarbon gases (like <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></math> ). This process X is called ________ and it is used to purify the metal that initially contain impurities of Y. Y is _______.

solution.text: Poling is a purification process which is used for metals which contains their own oxide as impurity.
